from pathlib import Path
import json

home=Path.home()
data=home/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
states=home/".local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks"
source="DEV-PRED-CONT-CANARY2-A-20261003-E022"
cid="CONT-e91d594cb6c782b9e7b2668d"

def load(p):
    try:
        return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None

s=load(states/f"{source}.json")
cp=data/"continuations"/f"{cid}.json"
c=load(cp)

checks=[
    ("A_STATE_MISSING", isinstance(s,dict)),
    ("A_NOT_DISPATCHED", isinstance(s,dict) and s.get("status")=="DISPATCHED"),
    ("A_AUTO_FALSE", isinstance(s,dict) and s.get("auto_continue") is True),
    ("A_CONTINUATION_RECORD_MISSING", cp.is_file()),
    ("A_CONTINUATION_INVALID", isinstance(c,dict)),
    ("A_CONTINUATION_ID_WRONG", isinstance(c,dict) and c.get("continuation_id")==cid),
    ("A_CONTINUATION_SOURCE_WRONG", isinstance(c,dict) and c.get("source_task_id")==source),
]

for name,ok in checks:
    if not ok:
        print("E024_FIRST_FAIL="+name, flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(7)

state=c.get("state")
event_id=c.get("last_event_id")
loc=[]
if event_id:
    for n in ("outbox","inflight","sent"):
        if (data/n/f"{event_id}.json").is_file():
            loc.append(n)

if state not in {"CONTINUE_REQUESTED","CONTINUE_QUEUED","CONTINUE_SENT","NEXT_TASK_CREATED","NEXT_TASK_ACCEPTED"}:
    print("E024_FIRST_FAIL=A_CONTINUATION_BAD_STATE state="+repr(state), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(7)
if not event_id:
    print("E024_FIRST_FAIL=A_CONTINUATION_NO_EVENT state="+repr(state), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(7)
if not loc:
    print("E024_FIRST_FAIL=A_CONTINUATION_EVENT_NOT_FOUND state="+repr(state)+" event="+repr(event_id), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(7)

print("E024_FIRST_FAIL=NONE state="+repr(state)+" loc="+",".join(loc), flush=True)
